paragraphs: Apply4 Technology sells cloud-based permitting and location library software to city and local governments. The work is grouped under three names, FilmApp, EventApp and LocationDB.

FilmApp puts film permit applications online, which the company frames as both simple and inexpensive for a city. EventApp handles special event permits, promising faster turnaround and less work for staff. LocationDB is the location library, using AI to make a jurisdiction's locations discoverable.

The company says other city and local governments already benefit from its services. Prospective buyers are asked to schedule a demo. One contact address is on Great Suffolk Street in London. Another is in St. Petersburg, Florida. The footer gives the legal name as Apply4 Technology Limited.
